==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson was in the Were-Fish society defending it with his Lucid Light. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Were-Fish Society resembles an underwater city made up of glowing, orange, glass, dome shaped pods. There are orange roadways that weave throughout the city, that allow for cars to navigate between the underwater domes. The city is located underwater deep in a river beneath a bridge in the Elven Village.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
I gave him the Golden Trident as a symbol of his heroism. (The Golden Trident resembles a shimmering, glowing, golden, magic trident.)
We returned to the Elven Village and fought off any remaining Were-Shark invaders. (Were-Sharks resemble humanoid sharks.)
